target.title: fix(cli): keep UTF-8 log tails valid
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where CLI log tail output could show a UTF-8 replacement character when bounded stdout trimming kept the newest bytes starting in the middle of a multibyte character.

## Why This Change Was Made

`execFileUtf8Tail` now decodes truncated stdout from the next valid UTF-8 boundary instead of decoding a retained continuation byte. The change is limited to truncated stdout log tails; stderr and untruncated output keep their existing behavior.

## User Impact

Users reading bounded CLI log output get cleaner text when logs contain non-ASCII characters and the tail limit cuts through a character.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/logs-cli.runtime.test.ts`
  - `src/cli/logs-cli.runtime.test.ts` passed 4 tests in one shard after rebasing onto latest `origin/main`.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main`
  - `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`
